segments.text:
V. 25.
Whoſoever will ſave his life—At the Expence of his Conſcience: Whoſoever in the very higheſt Inſtance, that of Life itſelf, will not renounce himſelf, ſhall be loſt eternally. But can any Man hope, he ſhould be able thus to renounce himſelf, if he cannot do it in the ſmalleſt Inſtances? And whoſoever will loſe his life, ſhall find it—What he loſes on Earth, he ſhall find in Heaven.
